title: Inflammation in the context of acute decompensated heart failure and its impact on periodontal health
summary: Patients admitted to the hospital with acute heart failure will be asked whether they are willing to have their dental status examined in order to determine whether an acute deterioration of heart failure also affects periodontal disease.
conditions: In patients with acute cardiac decompensation due to heart failure requiring the administration of diuretics (oral or intravenous), the periodontal dental status will be assessed.

interventions.name: Patients with acute cardiac decompensation due to heart failure requiring administration of diuretics (oral or intravenous).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Acute cardiac decompensation due to heart failure requiring the administration of diuretics (oral or intravenous)
Signed informed consent form
Exclusion criteria:
Age <18 years
Lack of capacity to provide consent
Insufficient proficiency in the German language
Pregnant or breastfeeding patients
Patients institutionalized by governmental or judicial order
All individuals in a dependent or employment relationship with the sponsor or investigator
